summary: Clean Energy Technologies disclosed a convertible note financing with Pacific Pier Capital. The company issued a $406,000 convertible promissory note for net proceeds of $350,280 after expenses. The note matures in 12 months, bears 12% interest, and is convertible at 85% of the lowest VWAP after six months. Issuance of more than 2M shares requires Nasdaq shareholder approval. Use of proceeds is restricted to business development and service providers. This is a routine financing event, not a special situation like a tender or going-private transaction. Watch for the shareholder approval timeline by May 1, 2026.
